ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Funding Freeze on Child Care Programs
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's funding freeze on child care programs and its impact on vulnerable families.
questions: What are the motivations behind the funding freeze?
How will the funding freeze affect vulnerable families?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover a significant scandal, and I recommend investigating the administration's connections to special interest groups and the potential consequences of the funding freeze.
